section_summary: This section consists chiefly of company profiles listing capitalization, products, plant locations and sources for Japanese machine tool manufacturers. Several profiles also describe ownership, government support, expansion or wartime production. Page 219 introduces a group of companies with capitalization under ¥1,000,000.
